evidence: Fresh recomputation over all 147 committed main-class order-7 representatives reproduced rowHam [37], colHam [37,39], symHam [37], atomic [37], with index 39 counts (15,21,15).
Fresh recomputation over all 564 committed isotopy order-7 representatives reproduced rowHam [67,300], colHam [67,294], symHam [67,365], atomic [67].
Fresh recomputation over the committed first 300 order-8 main-class representatives found all 300 Latin, no Hamiltonian aspect, and per-aspect maxima 16.

Wanless (EJC 1999, R9; DOI 10.37236/1441) defines nu as a main-class invariant, gives nu(C_p)=6 for cyclic prime squares, and in the small-order classification identifies precisely the order-7 pan-Hamiltonian main classes, including noncyclic A7 with nu(A7)=2.

This prior result covers in substance the record's core order-7 main-class nu/Hamiltonicity classification. Exact McKay indices, orientations, and pair counts are database annotations rather than a new classification.
After prior-art coverage is removed, the order-7 remainder is chiefly representative-list indexing/orientation metadata and a replay certificate.
The order-8 fragment is only the first 300 of 283657 main classes and supports no classification or structural conclusion about the remaining classes.
No bounded correction leaves a contribution that is both original and scientifically substantive under the audit criteria.
